description: Use when the user asks whether a domain's DNS is secure or DNSSEC-signed, or why it fails on validating resolvers. Returns secure, insecure, bogus or unknown with DS and DNSKEY details. For name servers see nameservers, for certificate rules caa. Ex: 'Is the DNS of example.com secure?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.

domain.description: A public domain name, e.g. example.com.

name: dnssec
title: DNSSEC check
